newsitem.title: USA: IBM says cuts prices on two network printers.
newsitem.headline: IBM says cuts prices on two network printers.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp said Wednesday it is cutting prices on two models of its network printers, by up to nearly 20 percent.
IBM said the price of its network printer 12 has been cut 19 percent to $1,299 from $1,599, and its network printer 24 price has been cut 14 percent to $2,999 from $3,499.
The company also said it cut the price of its toner catridge for its network printer 24 by 15 percent to $219 from $257.50.
The printer price cuts are in the United States.
IBM also said it released its network printer manager software for open-standards network printers.

The company said the software allows customers to install and monitor network printers through an intranet using desktop Web browsers and can be downloaded for free from the IBM printing systems home page.
